exposure: persistent occiput posterior (OP) during the second stage of labor
duration of the first stage of labor
cohort: 495 women with fetuses in persistent OP position during the second stage of labor
finding: A shorter duration of the first stage of labor (< 7 h) was associated with spontaneous rotation of the fetal head in the second stage of labor, and spontaneous rotation was associated with better maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: There were fewer cesarean sections (0% vs. 5.4%, p = .03), and instrumental deliveries (8.9% vs. 50%, p < .01) in the 'spontaneous rotation' group.
